name: What is the typical process for weightlifting technique training at Cave Training?
description: It starts with an assessment, followed by personalized coaching in sessions or small groups. We use video analysis to provide feedback and clarify corrections.

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for weightlifting technique training at Cave Training?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process at Cave Training typically begins with an initial assessment to evaluate your current form and identify areas for improvement. Following this, you'll receive personalized coaching through one-on-one sessions or small group classes focused on specific lifts. We often use video analysis to provide immediate feedback and help you visualize corrections, allowing for a clearer understanding of necessary adjustments and accelerating your learning curve.
